node.label: Ira Berlin
node.date_label: Slaves Without Masters (1974) · Many Thousands Gone (1998) · Generations of Captivity (2003)
node.description: Historian of slavery and emancipation who emphasized geographical variation, change over time and enslaved people’s agency. Berlin’s1999 teaching forum sets North American slavery within Atlantic migration and cultural transformation. His Freedmen and Southern Society Project made emancipation documents available through collaborative editing; these collective credits remain distinct from his monographs.
